question: Who wrote the patriotic song ‘Sare Jahan Se Achha Hindustan Hamara’ that was published in the weekly journal Ittehad on 16 August 1904?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Iqbal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Iqbal** wrote the patriotic song 'Sare Jahan Se Achha Hindustan Hamara'.
 
• The song was published in the weekly journal **Ittehad** on **16 August 1904**.
 
• Muhammad Iqbal, also known as **Allama Iqbal**, was a prominent philosopher, poet, and politician in British India who is widely regarded as having inspired the Pakistan Movement.
 
• 'Sare Jahan Se Achha' is one of the most famous patriotic songs in India, reflecting the sentiment of pride and love for the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammad Iqbal** was born on **9 November 1877**, and he is considered one of the most important figures in Urdu literature.
 
• He is often referred to as **“Mufakkir-e-Pakistan” (The Thinker of Pakistan)**, **“Shair-e-Mashriq” (The Poet of the East)**, and **“Hakeem-ul-Ummat” (The Sage of the Ummah)**.
 
• Iqbal's vision of an independent state for Muslims in north-western India was to inspire the creation of Pakistan.
 
• His notable works include **“Asrar-e-Khudi”** and **“Bang-e-Dra”**.
